name: supabase
description: Supabase and PostgreSQL integration — Postgres migrations, Edge Functions, auth, RLS, data analysis, safe querying, and schema inspection.

setup.label: Supabase personal access token (Project Settings > API)
PostgreSQL connection string — use a read-only role (e.g. duya_reader); read-only access is enforced by the database role

interface.shortDescription: Supabase and PostgreSQL integration — migrations, Edge Functions, auth, data analysis, and schema inspection.
interface.longDescription: Supabase and PostgreSQL integration for development and read-only data workflows. Covers Postgres migrations, Edge Functions, auth and RLS audit, data analysis, safe querying, and schema inspection. Supersedes the former supabase-development and postgres-readonly plugins. Use the sub-skill appropriate to your task.
defaultPrompt: Audit RLS policies on public tables
Run a safe SELECT query on the users table
Analyze data distribution in the events table

skills.name: auth-and-security
skills.description: Audit Supabase auth configuration, RLS coverage, and service-role key exposure.

skills.name: edge-function-workflow
skills.description: Draft, review, and manage Supabase Edge Functions for webhook handling and serverless logic.

skills.name: migration-workflow
skills.description: Review and manage Supabase Postgres migrations safely.

skills.name: postgres-best-practices
skills.description: Review Postgres schema and query patterns against Supabase best practices.

skills.name: data-analysis
skills.description: Run analytical queries against PostgreSQL with explicit read-only guards.

skills.name: safe-query
skills.description: Run SELECT queries against PostgreSQL with read-only guards and query plan analysis.

skills.name: schema-inspection
skills.description: Inspect PostgreSQL schema: tables, columns, indexes, constraints, and relations.
